svg.text: Sliding Window · O(n) · Each slide costs two operations, not k.

g.text: First window of size 4 — sum it once, 4 additions.
Slide: drop 4, add 8. One subtraction, one addition — not 4.
Slide: drop 2, add 1. One subtraction, one addition — not 4.
Slide: drop 1, add 2. One subtraction, one addition — not 4.
Slide: drop 7, add 8. One subtraction, one addition — not 4.
Slide: drop 8, add 3. One subtraction, one addition — not 4.
Slide: drop 1, add 9. One subtraction, one addition — not 4.
Best window found in a single pass — O(n), not O(n·k).
